names.evidence: cytochrome b6/f complex subunit VI is the protein petL (ycf7) encodes. The record's CDS starts one codon after its own start: its /transl_except puts Met on 33995..33997, a CCT that no C-to-U edit can make AUG, while 33998..34000 is the ACG that editing turns into the start of ORF33 (Wakasugi et al. 1996, Table 1: ycf7 codon 14 AcG→AUG; Fig. 2).
